name: Wolfratshausen (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically black and white, charged above the centre with the city arms of Wolfratshausen (a black wolf on white).
history: Municipal flag of Wolfratshausen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Wolfratshausen arms — black wolf on white
